description: Fleet-safe runtime view designed for many Kubernetes pods. Fixed-card summaries do not multiply by instance; instance, signer, solver, and RPC topology is row-based and scrolls at constant text size. Every RPC and txmanager aggregation retains pod and instance. Endpoint is a pod-local ordinal; URLs and key material are never exported. Native Grafana Dashboard Schema v2 delivery; Prometheus queries are scoped by namespace, pod, job, and instance. Requires the metric families documented in the repository README.

spec.title: Runtime pressure
spec.description: Process-local concurrency and file descriptor pressure.

spec.title: RPC call counts
spec.description: Logical JSON-RPC calls in the selected range; these are counts, not rates.

spec.expr: (sum by (namespace, instance, pod, role, method, outcome) (increase(solver_bot_rpc_requests_total{namespace=~"${namespace:regex}",pod=~"${pod_regex:regex}",job=~"${job:regex}",instance=~"${instance:regex}"}[$__range]))) > 0

spec.title: RPC errors: what failed
spec.description: Bounded error classes by method. rpc_error is a returned JSON-RPC error (for example a revert), distinct from transport failure.

spec.expr: (sum by (namespace, instance, pod, role, method, outcome) (increase(solver_bot_rpc_requests_total{namespace=~"${namespace:regex}",pod=~"${pod_regex:regex}",job=~"${job:regex}",instance=~"${instance:regex}",outcome!="success"}[$__range]))) > 0

spec.title: Endpoint attempt counts
spec.description: Each endpoint ordinal is local to one instance and role. URLs are deliberately absent from labels.

spec.expr: (sum by (namespace, instance, pod, role, endpoint, outcome) (increase(solver_bot_rpc_attempts_total{namespace=~"${namespace:regex}",pod=~"${pod_regex:regex}",job=~"${job:regex}",instance=~"${instance:regex}"}[$__range]))) > 0

spec.title: RPC latency
spec.description: End-to-end request latency through response-body consumption.

spec.expr: histogram_quantile(0.50, sum by (namespace, le, instance, pod, role) (rate(solver_bot_rpc_request_duration_seconds_bucket{namespace=~"${namespace:regex}",pod=~"${pod_regex:regex}",job=~"${job:regex}",instance=~"${instance:regex}"}[$__rate_interval])))

histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (namespace, le, instance, pod, role) (rate(solver_bot_rpc_request_duration_seconds_bucket{namespace=~"${namespace:regex}",pod=~"${pod_regex:regex}",job=~"${job:regex}",instance=~"${instance:regex}"}[$__rate_interval])))

histogram_quantile(0.99, sum by (namespace, le, instance, pod, role) (rate(solver_bot_rpc_request_duration_seconds_bucket{namespace=~"${namespace:regex}",pod=~"${pod_regex:regex}",job=~"${job:regex}",instance=~"${instance:regex}"}[$__rate_interval])))

spec.title: RPC in-flight
spec.description: Calls whose response body has not completed.

spec.title: RPC success age
spec.description: Age of the last successful logical request by role.

spec.title: Instances
spec.description: Selected active runtime instances.

spec.title: Fallback overhead
spec.description: Selected-range counts. Extra attempts are endpoint attempts beyond logical calls.

spec.expr: clamp_min(sum by (namespace, instance, pod) (increase(solver_bot_rpc_attempts_total{namespace=~"${namespace:regex}",pod=~"${pod_regex:regex}",job=~"${job:regex}",instance=~"${instance:regex}"}[$__range])) - sum by (namespace, instance, pod) (increase(solver_bot_rpc_requests_total{namespace=~"${namespace:regex}",pod=~"${pod_regex:regex}",job=~"${job:regex}",instance=~"${instance:regex}"}[$__range])), 0)

spec.title: Transaction outcomes
spec.description: Terminal logical transaction counts by operation and outcome.

spec.expr: ((sum by (namespace, job, instance, pod, label, outcome) (increase(solver_bot_txmanager_requests_total{namespace=~"${namespace:regex}",pod=~"${pod_regex:regex}",job=~"${job:regex}",instance=~"${instance:regex}"}[$__range]))) > 0) * on (namespace, job, instance, pod) group_left (address) (solver_bot_txmanager_account_info{namespace=~"${namespace:regex}",pod=~"${pod_regex:regex}",job=~"${job:regex}",instance=~"${instance:regex}"})

spec.title: Admission and in-flight
spec.description: Current accepted work plus selected-range pre-admission rejections.

spec.expr: (sum by (namespace, job, instance, pod, label) (solver_bot_txmanager_inflight{namespace=~"${namespace:regex}",pod=~"${pod_regex:regex}",job=~"${job:regex}",instance=~"${instance:regex}"})) * on (namespace, job, instance, pod) group_left (address) (solver_bot_txmanager_account_info{namespace=~"${namespace:regex}",pod=~"${pod_regex:regex}",job=~"${job:regex}",instance=~"${instance:regex}"})

((sum by (namespace, job, instance, pod, label, reason) (increase(solver_bot_txmanager_admission_rejections_total{namespace=~"${namespace:regex}",pod=~"${pod_regex:regex}",job=~"${job:regex}",instance=~"${instance:regex}"}[$__range]))) > 0) * on (namespace, job, instance, pod) group_left (address) (solver_bot_txmanager_account_info{namespace=~"${namespace:regex}",pod=~"${pod_regex:regex}",job=~"${job:regex}",instance=~"${instance:regex}"})

(histogram_quantile(0.50, sum by (namespace, le, job, instance, pod, label) (rate(solver_bot_txmanager_lifecycle_duration_seconds_bucket{namespace=~"${namespace:regex}",pod=~"${pod_regex:regex}",job=~"${job:regex}",instance=~"${instance:regex}"}[$__rate_interval])))) * on (namespace, job, instance, pod) group_left (address) (solver_bot_txmanager_account_info{namespace=~"${namespace:regex}",pod=~"${pod_regex:regex}",job=~"${job:regex}",instance=~"${instance:regex}"})

(histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (namespace, le, job, instance, pod, label) (rate(solver_bot_txmanager_lifecycle_duration_seconds_bucket{namespace=~"${namespace:regex}",pod=~"${pod_regex:regex}",job=~"${job:regex}",instance=~"${instance:regex}"}[$__rate_interval])))) * on (namespace, job, instance, pod) group_left (address) (solver_bot_txmanager_account_info{namespace=~"${namespace:regex}",pod=~"${pod_regex:regex}",job=~"${job:regex}",instance=~"${instance:regex}"})

(histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (namespace, le, job, instance, pod, label, phase) (rate(solver_bot_txmanager_phase_duration_seconds_bucket{namespace=~"${namespace:regex}",pod=~"${pod_regex:regex}",job=~"${job:regex}",instance=~"${instance:regex}"}[$__rate_interval])))) * on (namespace, job, instance, pod) group_left (address) (solver_bot_txmanager_account_info{namespace=~"${namespace:regex}",pod=~"${pod_regex:regex}",job=~"${job:regex}",instance=~"${instance:regex}"})

spec.title: Gas used
spec.description: Receipt gas units in the selected range.

spec.expr: ((sum by (namespace, job, instance, pod, label, outcome) (increase(solver_bot_txmanager_gas_used_total{namespace=~"${namespace:regex}",pod=~"${pod_regex:regex}",job=~"${job:regex}",instance=~"${instance:regex}"}[$__range]))) > 0) * on (namespace, job, instance, pod) group_left (address) (solver_bot_txmanager_account_info{namespace=~"${namespace:regex}",pod=~"${pod_regex:regex}",job=~"${job:regex}",instance=~"${instance:regex}"})

spec.title: Fees paid
spec.description: Actual receipt gasUsed × effectiveGasPrice, not an estimate.

spec.expr: ((sum by (namespace, job, instance, pod, label, outcome) (increase(solver_bot_txmanager_fee_paid_wei_total{namespace=~"${namespace:regex}",pod=~"${pod_regex:regex}",job=~"${job:regex}",instance=~"${instance:regex}"}[$__range])) / 1e18) > 0) * on (namespace, job, instance, pod) group_left (address) (solver_bot_txmanager_account_info{namespace=~"${namespace:regex}",pod=~"${pod_regex:regex}",job=~"${job:regex}",instance=~"${instance:regex}"})

((sum by (namespace, job, instance, pod, label, kind) (increase(solver_bot_txmanager_replacements_total{namespace=~"${namespace:regex}",pod=~"${pod_regex:regex}",job=~"${job:regex}",instance=~"${instance:regex}"}[$__range]))) > 0) * on (namespace, job, instance, pod) group_left (address) (solver_bot_txmanager_account_info{namespace=~"${namespace:regex}",pod=~"${pod_regex:regex}",job=~"${job:regex}",instance=~"${instance:regex}"})

spec.title: Unready
spec.description: Selected runtime instances whose shared readiness gate is closed.

spec.expr: count(max by (namespace, job, pod, instance) (solver_bot_service_ready{namespace=~"${namespace:regex}",pod=~"${pod_regex:regex}",job=~"${job:regex}",instance=~"${instance:regex}"})) - sum(max by (namespace, job, pod, instance) (solver_bot_service_ready{namespace=~"${namespace:regex}",pod=~"${pod_regex:regex}",job=~"${job:regex}",instance=~"${instance:regex}"}))

spec.title: Account snapshot health
spec.description: Refresh counts and retained snapshot age; failed refreshes do not zero balance or nonce gauges.

spec.expr: ((sum by (namespace, job, instance, pod, outcome) (increase(solver_bot_txmanager_account_refreshes_total{namespace=~"${namespace:regex}",pod=~"${pod_regex:regex}",job=~"${job:regex}",instance=~"${instance:regex}"}[$__range]))) > 0) * on (namespace, job, instance, pod) group_left (address) (solver_bot_txmanager_account_info{namespace=~"${namespace:regex}",pod=~"${pod_regex:regex}",job=~"${job:regex}",instance=~"${instance:regex}"})

(clamp_min(time() - solver_bot_txmanager_account_last_successful_refresh_timestamp{namespace=~"${namespace:regex}",pod=~"${pod_regex:regex}",job=~"${job:regex}",instance=~"${instance:regex}"}, 0) * (solver_bot_txmanager_account_last_successful_refresh_timestamp{namespace=~"${namespace:regex}",pod=~"${pod_regex:regex}",job=~"${job:regex}",instance=~"${instance:regex}"} > bool 0)) * on (namespace, job, instance, pod) group_left (address) (solver_bot_txmanager_account_info{namespace=~"${namespace:regex}",pod=~"${pod_regex:regex}",job=~"${job:regex}",instance=~"${instance:regex}"})

spec.title: Solver assignment
spec.description: Config-time solver membership by execution pod and process; this is topology rather than traffic inference.

spec.title: RPC endpoint health
spec.description: Freshness by execution pod, role, and role-local endpoint ordinal. Never means a configured fallback has not yet been needed successfully. Configured RPC URLs are intentionally never exported.

spec.title: Fleet instance status
spec.description: One row per selected execution pod/process. Rows remain fixed-size as the fleet grows; the table scrolls instead of shrinking values. Metric drops expose code/spec drift in bounded workflow instrumentation.

spec.expr: max by (namespace, job, pod, instance, address) (solver_bot_txmanager_account_info{namespace=~"${namespace:regex}",pod=~"${pod_regex:regex}",job=~"${job:regex}",instance=~"${instance:regex}"})

spec.title: Configured solvers
spec.description: Solver memberships across the selected runtime instances.

spec.title: Transaction signers
spec.description: Distinct process-scoped transaction-sender identities in the selected fleet.

spec.title: Admission wait p95
spec.description: Leading indicator for nonce-lane saturation, split by request label and terminal admission outcome.

spec.expr: (histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (namespace, le, job, instance, pod, label, outcome) (rate(solver_bot_txmanager_admission_wait_duration_seconds_bucket{namespace=~"${namespace:regex}",pod=~"${pod_regex:regex}",job=~"${job:regex}",instance=~"${instance:regex}"}[$__rate_interval])))) * on (namespace, job, instance, pod) group_left (address) (solver_bot_txmanager_account_info{namespace=~"${namespace:regex}",pod=~"${pod_regex:regex}",job=~"${job:regex}",instance=~"${instance:regex}"})

spec.title: RPC by instance and endpoint role
